description: Optional Log Analytics reporting sink (enhanced/history mode). Single source of truth for the custom tables, the DCR stream declarations (Bicep) and the collector row mapping (backend). All timestamps are UTC. TimeGenerated is the collection snapshot time (run start), so delivery lag = ingestion_time() - TimeGenerated. RecordKey is a deterministic idempotency key: the Logs Ingestion API is not idempotent, so retries can duplicate rows and every query de-duplicates on RecordKey.

retention.note: 13 calendar months is at most 397 days; Analytics-plan interactive retention (not archive) so history is directly queryable.

tables.name: ComplianceCollectionRuns_CL
tables.description: One row per collector run. A failed or partial run is recorded as such; sink delivery problems never change these values.

columns.name: RecordKey
columns.description: Idempotency key (hash of stream and run id).

columns.name: SentAt
columns.description: Collector clock when the batch was sent (last attempt).

columns.name: ReportsInserted
columns.description: New reports stored by this run.

tables.name: PolicyComplianceSnapshots_CL
tables.description: One row per run and baseline family: the three metrics, kept separate and never blended.

columns.name: RecordKey
columns.description: Idempotency key (hash of stream, run id and family).

columns.name: SentAt
columns.description: Collector clock when the batch was sent (last attempt).

columns.name: CollectionStatus
columns.description: Status of the run that produced the snapshot.

columns.name: PolicyCompliancePercent
columns.description: Compliant / (Compliant + NonCompliant); null when the denominator is 0.

columns.name: ChecksPassed
columns.description: Unique checks Compliant in Fresh reports.

columns.name: ChecksFailed
columns.description: Unique checks NonCompliant in Fresh reports.

columns.name: CheckPassPercent
columns.description: Passed / total; null when total is 0.

columns.name: ReportsExcludedAsNotFresh
columns.description: Reports left out of the check pass rate because they were not Fresh.

columns.name: UnknownEligibility
columns.description: Machines whose OS evidence is unknown.

columns.name: UsableReportMachines
columns.description: Eligible machines with a usable report (Fresh, Stale or UnknownAge).

columns.name: FreshReportMachines
columns.description: Eligible machines with a Fresh report.

columns.name: AssignmentPercent
columns.description: Assigned / eligible; null when eligible is 0.

columns.name: UsableReportPercent
columns.description: Usable report / eligible; null when eligible is 0.

columns.name: FreshReportPercent
columns.description: Fresh report / eligible; null when eligible is 0.

columns.name: UnclassifiedPolicyStates
columns.description: Policy states that could not be assigned to a family.

tables.name: MachineConfigReports_CL
tables.description: One row per Machine Configuration report newly stored by a run (reports are immutable upstream).

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Snapshot time of the run that stored the report.

columns.name: RecordKey
columns.description: Idempotency key (hash of stream and report id).

columns.name: SentAt
columns.description: Collector clock when the batch was sent (last attempt).

columns.name: SubscriptionId
columns.description: Subscription id (not an authorization boundary in Logs).

columns.name: ReportEndTime
columns.description: Report end; freshness is judged on this.

tables.name: MachineConfigChecks_CL
tables.description: One row per check of a newly stored report. Reasons are carried as phrase and code only (never counted as checks).

columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Snapshot time of the run that stored the report.

columns.name: RecordKey
columns.description: Idempotency key (hash of stream, report id and check key).

columns.name: SentAt
columns.description: Collector clock when the batch was sent (last attempt).

columns.name: SubscriptionId
columns.description: Subscription id (not an authorization boundary in Logs).

columns.name: BenchmarkControlId
columns.description: Benchmark control id only when verified; usually empty.

columns.name: ReportEndTime
columns.description: End time of the owning report.
